**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
A nanophotonic neural network accelerator whose optical circuit layout is optimized via inverse design algorithms to achieve ultra-compact, high-density optical computing. Enables chiplet-scale integration of optical compute units with minimal footprint, critical for TCC interconnects where area and power budgets are constrained.
